book.name: 1 Korin
book.title: 1 Korin Polna Mimirini Tombaimoa, Korinnindm Kolvrowolalm Kristusnindm, Noinda Ambo Sahonam Avnam Hev.

content: Manimani Si Yimba Moainal Andrava Dumbvra Sesoasongolnaminiva.
Seh, kava yemba os vinv, yeoa beswonam levrapivolo, Sesoasongolna moainal andram, ten hev yem nis daswolalm vevm.
Yimba pevpa nonora av, almba nemetva, yimba os avna pevnatovna. Yimba numbulvna pevmba, wohahui velmba, patvmonalmba, sembayang vewuvmona vinilmba Sesoadaspolmba, nom snam owai, moamba eishovmoa.
Wo kava yemba ishunv, os owai, mongova yeriniva himba nomba ishovrava Sesoasongolnapopolva, osva ishovav, Yesusmba mueisowa wohvevra. Wo eva mongova osva ovavmoa, Yesusva mendekli, Sesoasongolhui.
Manimani snanovna snanovna moainal andrava, Sesoasongolnamini, heva os owai, mongal av Sesoasongolva, henaminiangas.
Monamba mindnam luhungu vev, hemba andra venalmba, heva os hona monamba mongawamonam prov mongal nongasta mendeklimini.
Monamba mindnam luhungu vev, noindava Sesoava indhanana englamonglarava andra vinvpa, wo honamba manimani phov Sesoa mongalnamini. Sesoanapopol pimba andra vinv, manimani pimba nonamba viwul vevpa.
Mana vemava Sesoasongolnamba nungliv ambara indhanarinirava, nonam owalm kolvrowol velm.
Sesoasongolva daswolv henom henom, moalamang nonapopolmba isholmba. Noi mongal Sesoasongolva hevna moalamangva kokorasowolv, wo mongova moalamang nonapopolm isholm, mongomba, moam isholm nowolnam.

Noi mongal Sesoasongolva vraohv indhanarinimba undva, nona keknamangas undnahonam amnavm Sesoam. Wo noita mongal Sesoasongolva vraohv moainal andramba mongomba, nonamba uvavulnindmba sishona vewolalmba.

Mongova vravra moamba mendekli, nonapopolmba mendekli andram velm. Mongova vravra nowolva, Sesoana moamba ishomana vinilmba. Mongova vravra nowolva, osm lihawol velm, memba Sesoasongolnamini, eva tihsongonamini. Mongova vravra nowolva, isholmba annindna moana, annindna moana. Mongova vravra nowolva, lihawol velm hona annindna annindna moana plalm, Kristusnindm ishunilm.
Mongal Sesoasongolva nongasta vev honamba manam manam. Heva hev ambo daswolv hevna undna notongo notongo henom henom.
Pimba Indkumbiva Os Av, Snal Snal Nihsowosal Mongo Indhanarinina.

Indhanarinina nihva mongasalnonoa, heva os snal snal nihsowosalva no mongawa nihrangas wosapra luhungu vev. Lehra snavemal snavemal mongawanihrini, heva os nomba temba snal snal henga wosapra lohv mongawanihra. Kristusva eva himba os lohvta.

Mongnindva pimba Yutanind, wo mongnindva pimba Yutana meisungund. Mongnindva pimba ombandhana andranindilm avm, wo mongnindva pimba avm kuwulhui. Heva os pimba indkumbiva doa ponamba poswol vina, awothapralmba, mongawatindilmba almba Sesoasongolnanamba. Wo pimba doa nilhaprana, andra velmba mongasal Sesoasongolnanangas.
Pimba nonora av, nihva pinamba, nihsowosalva henamba mindnam, mongalva owai.
Monglava osva ollava, kava mani englama, noinda kava nihna nihsowosalva owai. Kela ov, mendah nihra kleihalohv.
Aongva osva ollava, kava mani novma, noinda kava nihna nihsowosalva owai. Kela ov, mendah nihra lehaiwo ahav.
Nihva osva novangasva elohollava, wo es ata eva helwolvav? Nihva osva aongangasva lehaiwo ahatava, wo es ata eva teihnungva levav nihva?
Nihsowosalva nihnamba mongawatovnamba liatava, temba nihnonoava owai. Heva os nihva snamba owai, Sesoava nihsowosalva wosana, os hev ten nengnam.
Noinda nihsowosalva mindnam liav mongawanihra.
Novpa osva omnavavmoa aongmba, kava yehuiva vevav. Wo kuva osva omnavavmoa monglamba, kava yehuiva vevav.
Owai, nomba nihsowosalva, nomba temba pimba osva nunglivpa, sendral, heva os owai, hehuiva es lohvav.
Wo snal snal nihsowosalva nihnamba sahoklalpeta, wo pimba mindnam nomba yunam kumeiv. Wo pimba temurava longong vewol vivpa no nihsowosalmba, osmba pimba kumeiv beswonam lounapenam.

Heva os monglava pivna nihsowosalva besalva, wo ambo nis pelnong vewol viv ambara nihpus. Sesoava vena nihmba mongasal, wo temura beswonam popeng vewol vivm, eva nomba nihsowosalva, temba ombamba lohpravpa.
Sesoava honamba vena, osm pinamba nihsowosalva owai, indakondakondava pevsangasangava wulowinvavmoa. Sesoava pimba os ninginv, snam snam pevna nihsowosalmoa longong vewol vivm.
Wo noinda osva mongnasisva nihva sesoa vetava, ata yunalm wohlehra vethavav nihsesoava. Mongova nihsowosalva snavemalva nihilva mendekliva vratava, ata huliva nihva indk vethavav.
Indkumbiva temba yimba avpa, nihsowosal snal snal snal Kristusna. Henoi henoi yimba indakondava eungu vev hena.

Wo Sesoava hevna andramba indhanamba wolawonamba, hindm honam. Vena, moalamangnindalm, vena, moashulnindilm, vena, guruwolm, vena, hem nom mendekli andram vaomana velm. Vena, indhanam uvavulmungilm vendindthoawolalm, wo eva osoa hem nom, owalm kokoldomb vewolalm, vena, kuwulm ilvahinilm andranindnam, vena hindm snam, himba annindna annindna moanam isholm.
Indkumbiva moalamangnindva avmoa. Es hevpa indkumbi avma moashulnindilmba. Indkumbiva avmoa guruwolmba. Indkumbiva vivmoa mendekliandrava.
Indkumbiva moapulva Sesoanaminiva ilvahvmoa, uvavulnindmba vendindthoawolalmba. Indkumbiva indakonda moanamba eishovmoa, indkumbiva weihaloh vewol vivmoa nomba moamba.
Heva os yeoa indkumbioa lo hlavm, dombolm mimirinim moainal andramba Sesoasongolnam, honam kava yemba isholmba vinv, wevsam longongrinim.
